visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black beanie and a blue-grey t-shirt stands in a modern living room. He has white tape or makeup mimicking a goatee on his face and holds a silver coin. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) The camera zooms in on the man's hand as he attempts a spinning coin trick on his finger; comic-style radial lines and a white puff of smoke graphic appear behind him. (3) A group of five people—a young woman in white, an older man in a striped shirt, and three other youths—stand in a hallway, cheering and clapping enthusiastically. (4) A graphic screen appears with a cartoon cat wearing a chain and holding a mug, accompanied by Chinese text. (5) The man in the beanie attempts the magic trick again but fails; his expression is disappointed as yellow text overlays the screen. (6) A montage shows various crowd members looking skeptical or pointing fingers while whispering, set in the same hallway environment. (7) The man sits on a grey sofa, looking dejected, until he discovers packs of Extra gum on the coffee table. He takes two pieces and places them in his mouth. (8) A CGI sequence shows the man floating horizontally through a blue sky with clouds, then moving into a pink galaxy/space background, signifying a mental shift. (9) Returning to the living room, the man successfully performs the coin spin magic, glowing with a bright white circular aura. The crowd from earlier reappears, cheering wildly. (10) An older man in a striped shirt interacts with the man; as they talk, a CGI black hole opens on the floor, and the older man falls through it. (11) A product display shows two packs of Extra gum (Peppermint and Lime) against a white and yellow background with promotional text and price details.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM starts immediately with a male voice speaking in a fast, comedic Mandarin tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX accompanies a blowing sound, followed by a bright 'ding' chime. (3) A sudden burst of loud cheering, clapping, and high-pitched female laughter fills the track as the BGM maintains tempo. (4) A short 'fail' slide-whistle or cartoon buzzer sounds as the speaker's tone drops to a dejected, quieter mumble. (5) Muffled, overlapping whispers and scoffing noises represent the crowd mocking the performer. (6) A dramatic, ethereal synth swell and a 'crunch' SFX signify the eating of gum, followed by a cinematic riser. (7) The upbeat electronic BGM returns with even higher intensity and bass-heavy percussion during the successful magic trick. (8) A 'thud' SFX and a descending pitch shift occur when the older man falls through the floor. (9) The audio concludes with a clear, fast-paced commercial narration over a lighter, punchy pop-style musical jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous magic-show scenario to demonstrate that 'extra' sugar-free gum can help someone regain their 'good state' (focus/confidence) after a failure. It targets a young audience with meme-style editing and social-media-native graphics, culminating in a specific retail promotion for 7-Eleven.
